jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
About Finifi:

Founded in 2025, Finifi is an Operations AI platform for enterprises
, headquartered in Bangalore. In just 18 months, we’re already working with 75+ enterprises
, including Jyothy Labs, Aditya Birla, Balaji and Bikaji, helping them run critical operations across O2C, P2P, TMS and more
.
Founded by Rohan Desai and Anup Mishra
, who have previously built and scaled multiple SaaS companies with successful exits, Finifi sits at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, finance, supply chain and operations
.

Who this is for:

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building, shipping and solving real problems
.
You’ll work closely with the founding and product teams to build features used by real enterprise customers, with ownership across the frontend, backend, APIs, database and product experience
.

What you will do:

Build and ship product features using Next.js

Develop clean, responsive and intuitive frontend experiences
Build backend APIs and services using Node.js

Work with MongoDB
and design efficient data models
Integrate APIs, third-party services and AI capabilities
Debug, optimize and improve existing product workflows
Work closely with founders and product to turn ideas into production-ready features
Own features end-to-end — idea → development → deployment

What success look like:

You’ll be expected to ship quickly, take ownership and solve problems independently
.
You’ll start by building across the stack and gradually take ownership of larger parts of the product, including architecture, technical decisions and performance.
The goal isn’t just to write code — it’s to build products that solve real enterprise problems
.

What we are looking for:

Strong fundamentals in JavaScript / TypeScript

Hands-on experience with Next.js and Node.js

Experience working with MongoDB

Understanding of REST APIs and backend development
Comfortable working across frontend and backend
Good understanding of Git and software development practices
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Ability to learn quickly and work independently
Strong bias towards building and shipping

Prior startup or personal project experience is a plus

What we are offering:

₹20,000/month stipend

Work directly with the founding and product teams
Build software used by 75+ enterprise customers

End-to-end ownership across the stack
Exposure to AI, enterprise SaaS and real-world business workflows

Opportunity to contribute to product and technical decisions
A fast-moving team that values learning, ownership and speed

If you love building products, want real ownership, and want to work at the intersection of AI and enterprise software, this role is for you.

jobs.title: Python Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Python Full Stack Developer Intern
Location:
Remote
Duration:
4 Months
Type:
Internship (Full-time)
Stipend:
Unpaid / No Stipend
About the Role

We are looking for passionate and technically curious Python Full Stack Developer Interns to support our development team in building and maintaining full-stack web applications. You will work across frontend and backend development, including React-based interfaces, Python-powered APIs, and production-ready application integrations.
Key Responsibilities

• Backend Development:
Develop and maintain Python-based backend services, APIs, server-side logic, and database integrations.
• Frontend Development:
Build React.js applications, reusable UI components, and responsive interfaces for web and mobile platforms.
• API & System Integration:
Design and integrate RESTful APIs while ensuring smooth communication between frontend and backend systems.
• Application Development:
Implement authentication, security practices, debugging, testing, and performance optimization.
• Collaboration:
Work with designers, AI, and product teams while contributing to code reviews, documentation, and Git-based workflows.
Required Skills

• Strong understanding of Python programming and backend fundamentals.
• Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, and JSX.
• Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and styling frameworks like Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap.
• Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and frontend-backend communication.
• Familiarity with SQL or NoSQL databases.
• Understanding of authentication, data validation, error handling, and Git/GitHub.
Educational Qualification

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
What You Will Gain

• Hands-on experience building full-stack applications for real-world products.
• Exposure to Python backend systems, React frontend development, APIs, databases, and security practices.
• Opportunity to collaborate with frontend, AI, and product teams.
• Certificate of Completion, Letter of Recommendation (LOR) for high performers, and development of technical and problem-solving skills.

Show more

Show less
